exports.description: List of directories to export via NFS. Each entry defines a path and optional client access rules.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to export (e.g., /data/shared). Required.

clients.description: List of client hosts or networks and their export options. Each defines who can mount and what access they have.

host.description: Client host (hostname, IP, IP range in CIDR notation, or wildcards like * or *.example.com).

opts.description: List of NFS export options (e.g., ro, rw, sync, async, no_subtree_check, no_root_squash).
